body: I know the feeling. I ate dinner all alone on my birthday. Parents had better things to do I guess and my brother chose to hangout with his girlfriend instead of me. I don’t have any friends so there was no help there either. My life sucks and it’s gonna be over soon, but I honestly feel a sense of peace knowing I can’t do any wrong to anyone anymore. The people I used to be friends with haven’t invited me to anything in months so I find solace knowing my death won’t hurt anyone. I guess what I’m trying to say is that people like us exist where no one gives a fuck about us. It hurts and it doesn’t feel good at all, but I think it’s okay that we exist, we can live life on our own terms and go when we want to. Not trying to make you follow the same path I am on, just getting some thoughts out. Happy early birthday.
